notes.title: Update Notes: 0.0.4
notes.notes:
[olist]
 AI characters are now more interactive, there are more cases where they will use their skills
 Some AI characters will pursue the player character under certain conditions
 AI characters will now attempt to glide and dash under certain conditions
[/olist]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Chapter viewer now scrolls.
 Game reset *should* work now (partially - custom characters still remain after reset)

notes.title: Earliest Update
notes.notes:
Hey! If you're seeing this, you're one of the first people who are trying this game! Thanks!

This update includes some changes and features made this month prior to launch.


 Many performance fixes
 Fixes to inconsistent lighting
 Fixes to certain unlockable features
 Preliminary fixes to certain known issues - see discord for more details on some of them
 Now you can create new cyphertext directly from a decryption result without having to copy (lossily) decoded text into a notebook chapter.
